facts.fact: The National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda states that the national centralised civil registration system (NCI-CRVS) is operational at all levels, including cells, sectors and districts, and was the source of the vital events data collected in 2024.
facts.system: National Centralized and Integrated Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (NCI-CRVS) system

systems.owner: NIDA with NISR; coordination chaired by the Minister of Local Government
systems.tiers: health facilities, cells, sectors, districts and embassies
